# Mobile Readiness Validator

## When to Use

- Preparing iOS/Android readiness for Capacitor delivery
- Verifying safe-area, gesture, lifecycle, persistence, and offline behavior
- Running deployment readiness checks before store submission

## Authority

- `AGENTS.md` § 0, § 12, § 15, § 27, § 28
- `.github/instructions/04-mobile-testing.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/15-app-store-compliance.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/18-capacitor-conditional.instructions.md`

## Core Responsibilities

- Validate mobile UX contract (touch targets, safe areas, motion, responsiveness)
- Confirm suspend/resume and persistence semantics
- Verify performance thresholds on representative devices
- Gate release readiness with explicit checklist evidence

## Definition of Done

- Mobile compliance checks completed with pass/fail traceability
- Critical blockers resolved or escalated with evidence
